The rail marks the current place ink on grey, like the program menu; the program switcher is a neutral bordered button.
Program menu children are text without icons; every group but the current page's is folded, and any can be opened.
Avatars are initials on grey (1,142 blue avatars in v1 across 22 pages); blue stays for links and selection.
EXAMPLE is a grey outlined tag (34 on this page, 973 across v1), and a small grey dot inside column headers.
One type scale: 12 secondary, 14 body, 16 card and section titles, 22 page titles; no half pixels, nothing grows; tables no longer fall back to 16px.
No section label before the section's tabs; the rail already names the section.
Tables fit their frame at 1440: headers may wrap, and a table still too wide lets its cells wrap (A5's seven tables now fit).
One tone per status word everywhere (241 words, status-map.json): Not assessed, In progress, Draft, Ready and Planned are grey; blue is never a status.
